contracts.title: Safety power boundary
contracts.description: Constrains the declared voltage, current, hazard, certification, and intended-use boundary.

contracts.title: USB-C CC termination
contracts.description: Fixes the USB-C sink CC1 and CC2 termination topology and resistor values.

contracts.title: I2C bus pull-up
contracts.description: Fixes the I2C SDA and SCL pull-up topology and resistor values.

contracts.title: ESP32-C3 strapping boot
contracts.description: Fixes the ESP32-C3 strapping-pin, boot-button, and firmware assignment topology.

contracts.title: Firmware pin map
contracts.description: Fixes every declared firmware GPIO assignment against the MCU electrical pad map.

contracts.title: Single LDO power tree
contracts.description: Fixes the single-LDO rail topology, capacitor values, and pinned decoupling distances.

contracts.title: LED current limit
contracts.description: Requires a declared series element between the LED drive pin net and the LED anode net.

contracts.title: High-speed signal integrity
contracts.description: Constrains declared differential-pair symmetry and impedance geometry against the stackup.

contracts.title: Redundant path independence
contracts.description: Checks declared redundant members for forbidden shared single-point resources.

contracts.title: Protection selectivity
contracts.description: Checks declared power-tree protection ordering and containment.

contracts.title: Signal-class segregation
contracts.description: Checks incompatible signal classes at connectors and across placement boundaries.

contracts.title: Critical sneak path
contracts.description: Checks declared critical nets for unintended passive, indicator, and labeling paths.

contracts.title: Conductor current capacity
contracts.description: Checks IPC-2221 capacity using declared trapezoidal conductor geometry.
